resources.string: No anime in this MyAnimeList view
Connect MyAnimeList in Tracking settings, then refresh its list or choose another status. Playback resume positions remain local.
Anime watchlist and completed episode tracking
Connect your own account, manage your anime list, and sync completed episodes.
Scan with your phone and authorize Syclop on MyAnimeList. This connection expires after five minutes.
Keep this screen open. Your phone must be on the same home network as the TV. The temporary callback listener closes after sign-in, cancellation, or expiry.
If the registered callback cannot reach the TV, paste the full returned callback URL below. Its state must match this connection.
MyAnimeList sign-in becomes available after the Syclop developer configures this app registration once. Users do not register their own developer applications.

Saves completed episodes at 80% playback or later, only when the player has a known MAL ID and matching season-specific episode number. No title guesses or season conversions. Local resume positions remain in Syclop.

Register Syclop as your native application at https://myanimelist.net/apiconfig. Enter your application client ID and exact registered redirect URI. This is shared app setup; each profile signs into its own MAL account. Do not enter a client secret.

For phone sign-in on this home network, register the suggested TV HTTP callback exactly. MAL must accept that URI in your registration. If registration rejects a private HTTP address, use a registered HTTPS callback you control and return its full callback URL manually. No third-party account keys are reused.
